title: Life Plan Bulletin: Entrance Plan Discounts and Respite Conversion Credits on Assisted Living Accounts
content:
**For households holding an Entrance Fee Agreement or arriving from a Larkspur respite stay, on the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

### Entrance plan discount credits — clauses in force

- No discount is given to add-ons, late fees or the community fee.
- No discount is posted once the Entrance Fee Agreement has left occupied status, whatever the service days of the charge.
- An entrance plan discount is posted at most once per charge entry.

### Retired clauses — no longer in force

The following clauses are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis: "Holding an Entrance Fee Agreement changes what an assisted living resident pays: while the customer holds an Entrance Fee Agreement in occupied status, each rent charge and each care fee charge receives an entrance plan discount credit referencing that charge and the agreement." and "The discount percentages are the care fee discount percentage and the rent discount percentage of the agreement's plan, set in the Entrance Fee Agreement terms, each applied to the charge amount and rounded to the cent half up."

### Respite conversion credit

A respite conversion credit is posted only as the consequence of a converted Larkspur respite stay under a Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, for the amount the respite terms fix, and carries the respite stay it comes from. Each respite stay yields at most one conversion credit across all residencies.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical)

| Situation | Outcome under the clauses in force |
|---|---|
| A guest meal charge of a Life Plan household | No discount (an add-on) |
| A late fee of a Life Plan household | No discount |
| An Entrance Fee Agreement now in terminated status, rent charge for a month when it was still occupied | No discount posted |
| A care fee charge that already carries an entrance plan discount | No second discount |
| A respite stay already credited to a memory care residency | No conversion credit to the assisted living residency |

superseded_clauses: Holding an Entrance Fee Agreement changes what an assisted living resident pays: while the customer holds an Entrance Fee Agreement in occupied status, each rent charge and each care fee charge receives an entrance_plan_discount credit referencing that charge and the agreement.

The discount percentages are care_fee_discount_pct and rent_discount_pct of the agreement's plan, set in the Entrance Fee Agreement charter, each applied to the charge amount and rounded to the cent half up.
